title: Edge-of-Chaos
description: Falsifiable research programme and digital-twin metrology platform (Python + Rust) testing the necessary physical conditions for primary interoceptive sentience in continuous neuromorphic substrates.
notes: v0.2.0 corrects the SDE integration (spurious Milstein term for additive noise; wrong initial state) and stops presenting the digital twin's dissipation terms as Hatano-Sasa quantities: they are heuristic proxies that depend on the integration step. See CHANGELOG.md for details and known open issues.
